description.narrative:
Tertiary scholarships are offered to Solomon Islands to progress development and workforce planning objectives. Anticipated outcomes include:
  • Scholar capability is increased
  • Scholars develop personal and professional connections to each other
  • Affinity is increased between New Zealand and scholars through a positive scholarship experience
  • Bilateral and regional objectives are supported by the Scholarships Programme
